source: Checkpoint reports from two cooperating design tasks; private task and artifact pointers retained privately.

pilots.reported_observation: Independent proposals followed by written cross-examination exposed a combined date-and-attendance action and missing consequences. Some reviewer suggestions introduced unsupported assumptions and were rejected by the lead.
pilots.decision: Routine factual and interaction corrections proceeded; materially different product approaches remained available for the user's choice.
pilots.artifact_state: Concept boards reportedly delivered and separately reviewed; no implementation or live participant changes.
pilots.user_acceptance: positive reported selection of five underlying concepts; no layout or implementation approval

later_checkpoint.reported_observation: A concrete two-route scenario showed that clarifying an upstream requirement could remove a downstream reassignment question. A worker incorrectly generalized one group capacity to another; the source check rejected this.
later_checkpoint.decisions_preserved: Two structural alternatives remained: complete plans versus a current draft with attached decisions. No preference winner established.
later_checkpoint.handoff_failure: Three initial read-only attempts failed because exact image filenames were omitted; corrected paths supported two independent retries and one shared challenge.
later_checkpoint.interpretation: A specific scenario exposed a wrong implied sequence. This does not identify the cause of user satisfaction or establish net savings.

pilots.reported_observation: An abbreviated source brief caused independent workers to infer insufficient content. Supplying already available facts corrected that inference. Agreement was not treated as evidence of user value.
pilots.decision: Factual repairs proceeded; subject relevance remained for the user's reaction to a concrete visual proposal. A previously planned element was explicitly excluded from pilot-caused improvements.
pilots.artifact_state: Three concept pages reportedly generated and independently reviewed; no image correction this round.
pilots.user_acceptance: positive reported response to delivered concepts and emerging workflow
pilots.timing_correction: Calls ran concurrently; the earlier reported 150 seconds was aggregate call time, not elapsed wait.
pilots.response_update: A later checkpoint reported that the user liked the result and found it closer to the intended experience; no software/publication approval or causal effect inferred.

scope: Motivates preserving source sufficiency, dissent, user authority and honest failure accounting in the protocol.
limitations: These reports are observational, involve different tasks and contain no competent controlled comparator.
Independent review reported by a task is not user acceptance.
They do not isolate the contribution of extra agents, discussion, reframing, or additional effort.
The public skill is not silently updated in either active pilot.
Pilot costs are separate from this upgrade's execution accounting.
